prompt: The thumbnail toolbar buttons stopped working after a Windows update. I need to understand how they work end-to-end. Walk me through the full flow from when the app starts to when a thumbnail button is clicked and the Qobuz player responds. Include all the key functions and how they connect.

assertions.name: mentions-init-thumbar
assertions.description: Answer mentions init_thumbar() stores AppHandle at startup

assertions.name: mentions-load-icons
assertions.description: Answer mentions load_icons() loading .ico files via LoadImageW

assertions.name: mentions-subclassing
assertions.description: Answer mentions SetWindowLongPtrW and window subclassing (register_subclass)

assertions.name: mentions-com-taskbarlist
assertions.description: Answer mentions ITaskbarList3 / ThumbBarAddButtons COM interface

assertions.name: mentions-wm-command
assertions.description: Answer mentions WM_COMMAND with THBN_CLICKED notification code

assertions.name: mentions-js-eval-selectors
assertions.description: Answer mentions that button clicks result in JS eval with CSS selector fallbacks

assertions.name: mentions-cleanup
assertions.description: Answer mentions cleanup_thumbar() / DestroyIcon for proper teardown
